text.ru: Время выезда — check-out time; I'd like to check out. Early — «рано» (наречие и прилагательное). leave — left — left.
text.en: Check-out time; I'd like to check out. Early works as an adverb and adjective. leave – left – left.
text.es: check-out; early = temprano. leave – left – left.
